description: Hybrid Electrical Fault Detection Dataset (Real + Synthetic) is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Maimoona Sabir, Muhammad Nabeel Ansari. This dataset is titled Hybrid Electrical Fault Detection Dataset (Real and Synthetic) and contains 22,000 labeled instances of electrical faults in three-phase power systems. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support industrial-facility and resource studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
